description: An organized structure set up for a particular purpose, such as a business, government body, department, charity, or financial institution that is working together with another organization, business, or person.

name.description: A name, expressed as text, for this cooperating organization.

roleCode.description: The code specifying the role for this cooperating organization.

usedInformationSource.description: A specified cooperative information source used for or from this cooperating organization.
